checks.description: A total wall-clock deadline is enforced
DNS resolution is bounded by the deadline
DNS worker lifecycle cannot leak a permanently blocked call

evidence.limitation: getaddrinfo cannot be cancelled; a hung resolver leaves one daemon worker until the OS resolver returns. Repeated hung resolutions could accumulate workers. Not reproduced offline.

checks.description: TCP connect has a bounded per-address budget

evidence.limitation: The watchdog closes the socket after TLS registration; the connect budget itself is enforced by the socket timeout.

checks.description: TLS verifies certificates and hostnames with a bounded timeout
Response headers have a bounded deadline
The response body has a bounded deadline and truncation cap
A clean EOF at deadline expiry is reported as a timeout
Truncated, invalid and incomplete bodies are never parsed as JSON
Transport failures return structured stage-aware errors
Sockets and responses are closed after success, failure and cancellation
The bounded transport refuses private addresses
Deadline cancellation is verified against a real OS socket

evidence.reason: All transport tests mock DNS, sockets and TLS. Mocked tests do not prove operating-system socket cancellation, and Phase 8 is forbidden from making a live network request.

checks.description: Transport failure is not retried and never falls back to a paid provider

evidence.note: The recorded Phase 7 fallback is a deterministic plan, not a paid provider.

fixes.change: post-body deadline guard: a clean EOF after deadline expiry is reported as deadline_exceeded, never as success
